description: Creates a public page for an event with a shareable link. Anyone who opens the link can save the event to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook or any other calendar. Returns the event with its link in url. Anyone with the link can see the event details, and the event is deleted 90 days after it ends.

endDate.description: End date as YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to the start date

endTime.description: End time as HH:MM, required with a start time

rsvpEnabled.description: Let guests accept or decline with their name

slug.description: Own link, e.g. summer-party for tap2cal.com/summer-party. At least 3 characters. Leave out for a link made from the name

startTime.description: Start time as HH:MM. Leave out for an all-day event

name: create_event
title: Create a calendar link
